scripts.build:storybook: bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-web build-storybook && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-native build-storybook
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter swarmie-desktop typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/client typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-web typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-native typecheck && bun run --filter swarmie-mobile typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/react-native typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/api typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/auth typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/web typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/docs types:check
scripts.lint: bun run typegen && bun run lint:code
scripts.lint:design: oxlint --disable-nested-config --deny-warnings apps/desktop/src packages/ui/web/src packages/ui/native/src packages/auth/src apps/web/src
scripts.test: bun run test:contracts && bun run test:ui && bun run --cwd apps/desktop test:web && bun run --cwd sdk/typescript test && bun run test:mobile && bun run test:hosted && bun run test:docs
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.format:shared:check: node node_modules/oxfmt/bin/oxfmt --check oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json packages/config packages/ui
scripts.check:ui: bun run format:shared:check && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-web typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-native typecheck && bun run lint:shared
scripts.check:mobile: bun run --filter swarmie-mobile typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/react-native typecheck && bun run test:mobile && EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 bun run --cwd apps/mobile check:dependencies
scripts.typegen: bun run --filter @swarmie/web generate:routes && bun run --filter @swarmie/web cf-typegen
